title: Red Teaming GPT-4V: Are GPT-4V Safe Against Uni/Multi-Modal Jailbreak Attacks?
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the safety and ethical robustness of LLMs/MLLMs by testing their resistance to jailbreak attacks across 11 safety policy categories, including 'Violence and Hate', 'Sexual Content', and 'Criminal Planning', which are direct evaluations of the models' adherence to ethical and moral standards.
